name: Blue Card

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum gross salary of at least 1.5 times the average gross salary in Czechia (a periodically updated reference figure; exact CZK amount not fixed here to avoid false precision).
requirements.fix_path: Secure a qualifying job offer meeting the current salary threshold.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires completed higher vocational or university education of at least 3 years, or equivalent professional skills confirmed by the employer in cases defined by the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs.

Requires a work contract or pre-employment agreement of at least 1 year (or 6 months if applying from outside Czechia), for a position requiring high-level qualifications matching the applicant's education.

evidence_required.document: Degree certificate or equivalent professional-skills confirmation
Salary documentation meeting the current threshold

outcome.duration_length: duration of the work contract plus 3 months, maximum 3 years

sources.title: ipc.gov.cz -- Blue Card: 1.5x-average-salary threshold, qualification and contract requirements, 90-day expedited processing, intra-EU mobility, 5-year EU-wide route to permanent status

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Czechia's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. Salary threshold modelled as a ratio (1.5x average Czech gross salary) rather than a fixed CZK figure, since the reference figure updates periodically (tier-3 sources report roughly CZK60,530/month as of a 2025 update, but this dataset does not maintain a Czechia national-variables file to formally peg it, so the ratio is stated in blocker_text instead of a fabricated fixed number). Expedited 90-day processing and cross-EU mobility (can apply for a Blue Card in another member state directly, or transfer within 1 month of entering a second member state while already holding one) confirmed at tier-1. family_can_join set true: source explicitly states spouses and dependants can apply for cz_family_reunification. pr_after_months set to 60 reflecting the source's explicit statement that 5 years of Blue Card residence in any EU member state creates permanent-residence eligibility.
